name: 24018 · Roanoke, VA
findings: ZIP 24018 (Roanoke) has 148 nonprofit organizations. 79 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 57 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24018 (Roanoke) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 24018 (Roanoke) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
